## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; weak breadth plus mixed leadership confirm low conviction (SPY CORRECTION (1W: -1.67% | 1M: +0.63%) and QQQ BELOW TREND (1W: -1.98% | 1M: -3.04%)). VXX showing short-term uptick RECOVERY (1W: +4.99% | 1M: -5.66%) adds a second independent confirmation of caution.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit underperformance: HYG BELOW TREND (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -0.34%) and LQD BELOW TREND (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -2.09%) → credit stress edging higher; volatility pickup: VXX RECOVERY (1W: +4.99% | 1M: -5.66%) ↑ rising; narrow sector leadership with Energy leading.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-tightening: TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.24% | 1M: -3.16%) ↓ falling suggests higher yields, dollar and broad financial-condition ratios show flat NEUTRAL readings.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Energy leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ↑ rising; Utilities ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +2.43%) and Industrials ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.55% | 1M: +4.10%) provide defensive/cyclicals mix while Tech is RECOVERY: XLK RECOVERY (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -3.12%) — style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?  
US mixed: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -1.67% | 1M: +0.63%) while China shows RECOVERY-to-CORRECTION signals: FXI CORRECTION (1W: -0.20% | 1M: +4.96%) and EEM RECOVERY (1W: +0.64% | 1M: -3.83%).

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Muted: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.71% | 1M: +3.79%) shows crypto interest but ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -3.70% | 1M: -3.72%) and IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.18% | 1M: -1.09%) show limited small‑cap/speculative breadth.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Commodity strength concentrated in oil/ag: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +25.65%), USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +16.92% | 1M: +25.37%), CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +2.47%); gold in RECOVERY: GLD RECOVERY (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -1.54%).

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy dominant: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ↑ rising and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +25.65%) ↑ rising; natural gas mixed: UNG RECOVERY (1W: +1.82% | 1M: -7.74%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Energy (XLE ABOVE TREND) and select commodities show two‑timeframe confirmation; MAJOR divergence across core ETFs (SPY CORRECTION, XLK RECOVERY, XLF CORRECTION) signals reduced conviction and a transitional market.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor Energy/commodity exposure (XLE, BNO, USO) and industrial exposure while reducing exposure to large-tech and small-cap beta (QQQ BELOW TREND (1W: -1.98% | 1M: -3.04%), IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.18% | 1M: -1.09%)); monitor TLT and LQD for duration risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%), XBI ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.15% | 1M: +3.54%).  
BEARISH: XLK RECOVERY (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -3.12%), QQQ BELOW TREND (1W: -1.98% | 1M: -3.04%).

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +25.65%), USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +16.92% | 1M: +25.37%).  
BEARISH: UNG RECOVERY (1W: +1.82% | 1M: -7.74%), SLV RECOVERY (1W: +3.31% | 1M: -6.59%).

13. Key Levels?  
VXX (1W: +4.99% | 1M: -5.66%) ↑ rising — watch ~20 for complacency; HYG (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -0.34%) and LQD (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -2.09%) BELOW TREND — watch credit spreads; XLK (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -3.12%) RECOVERY vs XLF (1W: -1.62% | 1M: +3.62%) CORRECTION for sector rotation pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive, narrow leadership keeps conviction low. Energy and commodities showing strength while tech and broad risk indicators display divergence — monitor the SPY/XLK/XLF mismatch and credit signals (HYG/LQD).
